requirements.evidence: All contract pieces are present: Entity/EntityMembership/UserRole and factories (app/Models/Entity.php:14-49, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:12-68, app/Models/UserRole.php:5-18); named indexes `entities_slug_unique` and `entity_memberships_one_owner` with the stored generated owner_seq (database/migrations/2026_10_29_042754_create_entities_table.php:17, database/migrations/2026_10_29_042755_create_entity_memberships_table.php:18-26); pick endpoint with session/audit/redirect and 403-before-session (app/Http/Controllers/EntityController.php:16-27); all three Livewire pages with locked entity and mount authorization (app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:13-20, app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:22-33, app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:17-33); routes at routes/web.php:53-58; locale keys at lang/en/ui.php:50-72 and lang/pt_BR/ui.php:50-72; docs updated in docs/database-schema.md and docs/business-rules.md.

conventions.evidence: Mostly follows the project: `#[Validate]` in Members (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:25), table rules() plus $this->validate() in Settings (app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:38-58), policies for all authorization (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:14-50, app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:11-41), `#[Fillable]` attributes matching the User model (app/Models/Entity.php:14, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:12), migrations with reversible down(), and docs/CHANGELOG kept in sync. Deviation: domain writes and their authorization live in the Livewire components (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:38-104, app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:49-113) rather than in `app/Actions/*` as conventions.md:42-45 requires.

security.evidence: Every public action re-authorizes server-side (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:40,67,85; app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:51,69,89) and resolves client-supplied ids through the bound entity (Members.php:118-121, Settings.php:96-107); the entity is `#[Locked]` on all three components (app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:13, Members.php:22, Settings.php:17); pick authorizes `view` before touching the session (app/Http/Controllers/EntityController.php:18-20); all Blade output uses `{{ }}` and `#[Fillable]` keeps mass assignment narrow; unauthorized/tamper paths are denied (Employees 403, transfer 403 for non-admin/foreign/self/garbage targets).

tests.evidence: Comprehensive Pest coverage: pick success/403/session and guest+unverified (tests/Feature/EntityPagesTest.php:30-64), dashboard owner/non-owner/locale (:67-100), non-member 403 on every page (:102-119), employee-forbidden add/assign (:190-207), last-manager and owner-removal guards (:278-306), reassignment-after-demotion 403 for save/delete/transfer (:376-386), transfer targets/vanished owner (:427-494), locale key parity (:495-505); schema/second-owner DB rejection and policy matrices in tests/Feature/EntityModelTest.php:34-66,107-169.

simplicity.evidence: Lean implementation: 29-line controller, 28-line Dashboard, focused methods; reuses existing `<x-button>`/`<x-form-field>` components and the existing locale/docs structure rather than adding abstractions. Minor duplication: `roleOf()`/`isManager()` are copy-pasted between app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:42-50 and app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:33-41.

readability.evidence: Clear names and useful docblocks (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:115-131, app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:90-92, app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:21-23), small focused methods, and style consistent with the existing Laravel code. Only cosmetic nits: empty actions header at resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:23 and unused `@error('targetMembershipId')` at resources/views/livewire/entity/settings.blade.php:27.

scope.evidence: Every file in the diff serves the task: two migrations, the models/enum/factories/policies, one controller, three Livewire components plus views, routes, locale files, the two relevant docs and the changelog entry. No onboarding/switcher/middleware/billing work crept in.

issues.explanation: Membership and entity writes (create, role change, delete, ownership transfer) are performed and authorized directly in the Livewire components, whereas conventions.md:42-45 requires domain writes to be one Action class per use case in `app/Actions/*` with authorization inside the action.

`$targetMembershipId` is a public, client-writable property without `#[Validate]`/`rules()`, and `transfer()` never calls `$this->validate()`, contrary to Livewire rule 1 in conventions.md:131-133; impact is limited because the value is integer-filtered and must resolve to an admin of the bound entity before any write.
The `roleOf()` and `isManager()` helpers are duplicated between the two policies; one shared membership lookup would remove the copy-paste.
The actions column header is an empty `<th></th>`, so assistive technology gets no label for the role/remove controls in that column.
The `@error('targetMembershipId')` branch is dead markup: `transfer()` reports invalid targets with a 403 rather than a validation error on that key.

review.summary: The change implements the full entity data model (including the database-enforced single-owner invariant), models/enum/factories/policies, the entity-pick endpoint and the dashboard/members/owner-only settings Livewire pages, with docs and both locales kept in sync. Functionally and security-wise it is strong and ships thorough tests covering 403s, tampering and localization, but domain writes sit in the Livewire components instead of the mandated `app/Actions/*` classes, plus a few minor validation and markup nits.
